marketer.title: AI Marketer
marketer.subtitle: Product brief → market research → 4 strategy docs → ad creatives → straight into video production

trending.title: Thai Trending Videos, Ready to Replicate
trending.subtitle: Curated Thai viral ad patterns — clone any of them into an ad for your own product
trending.disclaimer: Figures are reference data as of {date}, not real-time — the system never pulls data from platforms directly

filters.empty: No videos match the selected filters

dialog.title: Replicate: {title}
dialog.desc: Creates an ad reference (the clip's pattern) in the selected campaign — then analyze → generate creatives with the existing flow
dialog.noCampaign: No campaigns yet — start by creating one below
dialog.created: Reference created from the trend — click "Analyze" in the campaign to continue

gallery.title: Creative gallery & results
gallery.subtitle: Every approved and produced ad creative across campaigns — log real results after posting, and they become evidence for the next research round
gallery.emptyDesc: Approve ad creatives and produce them in a campaign — they will show up here

dialog.title: Results: {title}
dialog.desc: Enter the real numbers from TikTok/analytics at the source — leave fields blank if not available
dialog.manualNote: The system never pulls platform data itself — the numbers you enter will be used as evidence in this campaign's next research round
dialog.notePlaceholder: e.g. Sales picked up after going live / lots of price questions

list.emptyDesc: Paste a product link or describe your product — AI researches the market, plans the strategy and writes ad scripts ready for production.

create.title: New marketing campaign
create.desc: Start from a product page link or fill in the product details yourself.
create.needProduct: Enter a product name or a product URL

form.productUrlHint: Fetch pulls the name, description and up to 6 images from the page. You can edit everything afterwards.
form.ingested: Product info fetched — review and edit below
form.ingestFailed: Could not read that page. Fill in the details manually.
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full link starting with http:// or https://
form.title: Campaign name
form.productDescriptionPlaceholder: Key features, ingredients, price, what makes it different…
form.imagesHint: Real product photos are used as references so generated videos show the actual product.
form.brandNotesPlaceholder: Tone of voice, USPs, words or claims to avoid…
form.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. Office workers 22–35 who commute daily
form.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Drive TikTok Shop sales during the 11.11 sale
form.aspectRatioHint: Used for every video produced from this campaign.
form.aspectRatioLocked: Locked — this campaign already has a production project.

delete.title: Delete campaign
delete.message: Delete “{title}” with all its documents and creatives? Projects already sent to production are kept.

work.notFound: Campaign not found (it may have been deleted)

running.research: AI is researching the product and market…
running.strategy: AI is writing the 4 strategy docs…

brief.title: Product brief
brief.desc: Everything the AI knows about your product comes from here. Edit any time — later steps use the saved version.
brief.budgetHint: Carried over to the production project for cost tracking.

research.title: Market research
research.desc: AI writes a product brief and a market research doc. Evidence from your link and notes is kept separate from model assumptions.
research.notesPlaceholder: Paste competitor links, customer reviews, pricing you have seen, sales data…
research.notesHint: Optional. Saved with the campaign and reused on the next run.
research.rerunHint: Updates both docs — previous versions stay in History.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.desc: Four docs built from the research. Edit, ask AI to revise, and approve each one.
strategy.rerunHint: Rewrites all 4 docs — previous versions stay in History.

doc.revisePlaceholder: e.g. Focus more on students and make the tone more playful

creatives.title: Creatives
creatives.desc: Ad angles with a hook, CTA and a production-ready script. Approve the ones you want to produce.
creatives.anyHint: Nothing selected = let AI choose from the strategy.
creatives.presetSet: Creatives will follow the structure of “{title}” and be appended to existing ones
creatives.replaceHint: Replaces draft creatives only — approved and in-production ones are kept.
creatives.empty: No creatives yet — choose options above and generate.
creatives.scriptHint: Keep the scene headers (## S1 {'|'} …) so the production pipeline can split shots.
creatives.deleteMessage: Delete the creative “{hook}”? This cannot be undone.

references.title: Ad references (Recreate Viral Ad)
references.desc: Paste a viral ad plus the transcript you typed out yourself. AI breaks down its structure and rewrites a fresh creative for your product on the same skeleton — no copied wording.
references.name: Nickname
references.transcriptPlaceholder: Type out the spoken lines and what is shown, moment by moment, e.g. 0-3s shows oily skin problem…
references.transcriptHint: The more detailed, the better AI captures the structure
references.noVideoNote: The system never downloads video from the link — the link is stored for reference only. AI analyzes the transcript you paste.
references.notesPlaceholder: Why you like it, view counts, etc.
references.empty: No favorite ads yet. Add one you want AI to learn the structure from.
references.deleteMessage: This permanently removes “{title}”. Creatives already created from it stay.
references.transcriptChangeWarn: Editing the transcript clears the existing structure analysis — you will need to analyze again.

visuals.title: Product visuals
visuals.desc: Generate fresh product images from a real photo — white-background packshot, model holding/using the product, or lifestyle shots.

instructionPlaceholder.packshot: e.g. clean white background with a soft shadow
instructionPlaceholder.on_model: e.g. Thai woman in her 20s holding the product in a café
instructionPlaceholder.lifestyle: e.g. on a wooden table by a big window, morning light

visuals.needSource: Pick a source product photo first
visuals.needBrief: Add product photos in the Brief step first to generate visuals
visuals.note: “White-background packshot” means the model creates a new image using your real photo as reference — not pixel-level background removal
visuals.costNote: Costs count toward the project budget only after you send work to production
visuals.failedHint: Image generation failed. Hit retry to try again.
visuals.promoted: This image is now a product photo

production.title: Production
production.desc: Each approved creative becomes an episode in this campaign’s production project, with the real product photos attached as references.
production.exportHint: Copies the research, strategy and creatives as one Markdown document.

quick.title: Learns your shop, then does the marketing
quick.subtitle: Give tasks in plain language: market analysis for TikTok Shop · Shopee · Lazada · Facebook · LINE, then campaigns and real video ads
quick.placeholder: Assign any marketing task, e.g. plan an 11.11 campaign for a cosmetics shop with a 5,000 THB budget
quick.templateHint: Template: {title} · fill in the [ ] parts for your shop

ways.title: Popular ways to get started

insight.title: Marketing insight
insight.desc: Pick a topic and fill in the [ ] parts; Naka turns it into a report with next actions

result.waiting: Naka is analyzing; this takes about 30–90 seconds…
result.noModel: No text model configured yet — set one in Settings → AI first
result.interrupted: The server restarted during the task; please try again
result.failed: The analysis failed; adjust the task and send it again

campaign.urlDesc: Paste a product page link: name, details and images are filled in, then AI runs research → strategy → video ideas, ready to produce on the campaign page
campaign.recreateDesc: Paste the spoken lines or scene notes of a winning clip; AI extracts its structure and writes a new clip for our product (no copied wording)
campaign.bulkDesc: One brief: AI researches, plans the strategy and splits it into several video ideas with different angles, ready to produce
campaign.fetched: Fetched — review and edit before starting
campaign.fetchFailed: Could not read the page automatically; fill in below

mode.structureDesc: Keep shots and pacing, all-new content
mode.structureNote: Mode: recreate structure — keep the shot structure, pacing and hook formula, write all-new content
mode.replaceDesc: Keep scenes and actions close, swap people or product
mode.replaceNote: Mode: replace elements — keep scenes, camera and pacing close to the original, swap only the person/product for ours

campaign.transcript: Spoken lines / scene notes of the reference clip
campaign.transcriptPlaceholder: e.g. [0-3s] Dull skin in the afternoon?… [3-8s] Wash with this…
campaign.transcriptHint: Nothing is downloaded from TikTok/Reels/YouTube — the link is kept for reference only
campaign.newContent: What the new clip should show
campaign.newContentPlaceholder: e.g. a Thai seller holding our product, value and fast shipping
campaign.briefPlaceholder: What the product is, verified benefits, price, promotion
campaign.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. office workers 25–35 with oily skin
campaign.autopilotNote: AI runs market research → strategy docs → video ideas in one go (with your text model), then press "Produce" on the ideas you like to make real videos
campaign.started: Started — AI is researching the market
